\[
\bigcup \{\, C_i : a_{\min} \le |C_i| \le a_{\max} \,\}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(C_i\): The objects
- \(a_{\\min}, a_{\\max}\): The smallest and largest area

C_i are the objects, the connected parts of the foreground, and |C_i| their areas in pixels. Objects with an area in the range are kept, all others become background.
